blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Amid discussions over a possible change in the voting threshold for convicting Vice President Sara Duterte in her impeachment trial, Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano warned that changing the rules midway could risk a mistrial. In a Facebook livestream, Cayetano said he would not want the 26-day proceedings to be restarted if changes to the rules were later found to have compromised the fairness of the trial. “I don’t want to have a mistrial. I don’t want all the work that has been done in this trial to go to waste,” the senator expressed. READ: Marcoleta won’t […]...
